text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. When did your fever start, and have you noticed any pain or changes in your vaginal discharge?

text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the uterine tenderness and postpartum fever, endometritis is a strong possibility, but I need to rule out other causes. Do you have any pain or burning when you urinate, and have you noticed any foul-smelling vaginal discharge?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Uterine tenderness. I also have Decreased bowel sounds, Increased frequency of urination, Fever.

text: I will check your vital signs and examine your abdomen for any signs of peritonitis or abscess. Please remain still while I palpate the area.
